title: Remove plan auto-removes nginx that EnvForge installed

verifyCommands: dpkg -s nginx 2>&1 | grep -q 'is not installed' || rpm -q nginx 2>&1 | grep -qi 'not installed'

notes: Post-condition: nginx package removed (or service stopped on rpm-based hosts where dpkg -s is N/A).
Data paths under /var/www/html / /var/log/nginx must NOT be touched (preserveData=true).
